pairsWith.noteUz: Butun kitob (1-15-unitlar) bo'yicha yakuniy nazorat testi: undov gaplar, 2-tur shart gap, So do I, majhul nisbat, past perfect, question tags, too/enough, the + familiya, miqdor iboralari, muloqot iboralari.

scanNote:
PROGRESS TEST 8 - Units 1-15, YAKUNIY (83-bet, PDF 72). Yuqorida to'q sariq 'PROGRESS TEST 8' va 'Units 1-15'. Katakchalar: NAME, CLASS, DATE, MARK, (Time: 40 minutes) - boshqa testlardan farqli 40 daqiqa.

'Vocabulary & Grammar':
1) 'Fill in the missing words.' 1 ...... clever of you to do this. 2 If I ...... you, I wouldn't eat so many sweets. 3 "I always wake up early." "...... do I." 4 ...... is the weather like today? 5 Who was America discovered ......? 6 He insists ...... going to sleep early. 7 He hadn't seen Rachel ...... last Monday. 8 ...... a lovely dress! 9 He asked me ...... stop talking. 10 It's ...... cold outside. 11 He didn't go to bed ...... he had finished his homework. 12 Will we have ...... time to do our shopping? 13 Do ...... Smiths own a car? 14 "...... do you travel to and from work?" "By bus." 15 She's ...... short to reach the cupboard. 16 What does your jacket ...... like? 17 She works as a lawyer, ...... she? 18 Can you please give me that ...... of honey over there? 19 Have you ...... flown in a hot-air balloon? 20 "How are you?" "......, thanks."
2) 'Choose the correct item.' 1 Newspapers give information on ...... events. A current B chat C on-line. 2 This is the ...... skirt of all. A cheap B cheaper C cheapest. 3 He ...... anything until she finishes. A hasn't done B doesn't do C won't do. 4 She's ...... Maths at university. A having B studying C learning. 5 The Internet is a great learning ...... for children. A tool B world C search. 6 Can you buy me a ...... of flour please? A bag B carton C box. 7 She's got a dark ...... . A hair B complexion C build. 8 Are you in ...... of children using the net? A favour B doubt C screen. 9 He's the cleverest student ...... his class. A from B of C in. 10 Does your watch show the correct ......? A minutes B time C hour.

'Communication':
3) 'Complete the dialogues.' 1 A: Would you like some coffee? B: Yes, please. And ...... some biscuits, too? 2 A: I'm sorry - what ...... your name was? B: Bill, Bill Stevens. 3 A: Someone stole Jack's bicycle. B: ...... pity! It was brand new. 4 A: Sorry I didn't come to your party. I was out of town. B: Never ...... . That's all right. 5 A: I've got a terrible cough. B: Why ...... some cough medicine?

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '83'.

exercises.explanationUz:
YAKUNIY TEST - 1-15-UNITLAR, 20 ta
  bo'shliq (40 daqiqa).

  UNDOV: HOW clever of you!; WHAT a
    lovely dress!
  ShART: If I WERE you, I wouldn't
  QO'ShILISh: SO do I
  OB-HAVO: WHAT is the weather
    like?; It's FREEZING cold
  MAJHUL: Who was America
    discovered BY?
  PAST PERFECT: hadn't seen SINCE
    last Monday; didn't go to bed
    UNTIL he had finished
  KO'ChIRMA BUYRUQ: asked me TO
    stop
  TOO/ENOUGH: ENOUGH time; TOO
    short to reach
  TAG: works as a lawyer, DOESN'T
    she?
  Boshqa: insists ON going; Do THE
    Smiths own?; HOW do you travel?;
    What does it LOOK like?; a JAR
    of honey; Have you EVER flown?;
    FINE, thanks.


⚠ 'FREEZING COLD':

  = muzdek sovuq.


⚠ 'TO INSIST ON':

  = ... da turib olmoq.

exercises.explanationUz:
YAKUNIY TEST - LUG'AT VA
  GRAMMATIKA.

  1 CURRENT events = joriy voqealar
  2 the CHEAPEST skirt of all
  3 He WON'T DO anything until she
    finishes (kelajak + until +
    present)
  4 STUDYING Maths at university
  5 a great learning TOOL = o'quv
    vositasi
  6 a BAG of flour = bir qop un
  7 a dark COMPLEXION = qoramag'iz
    teri

  9 the cleverest student IN his
    class

⚠ 'IN FAVOUR OF':

  = ... tarafdori, ... ni qo'llab.

MULOQOT IBORALARI - YAKUNIY.

  1 Muloyim so'rov → And COULD I
    HAVE some biscuits, too?
  2 Qayta so'rash → what DID YOU
    SAY your name was?
  3 Afsus → WHAT A pity!
  4 Uzrga javob → Never MIND.

  = yap-yangi.

patterns.formula: How + SIFAT + of you! / What a + OT!
patterns.exampleEn: How clever of you to do this! What a lovely dress!
patterns.exampleUz: Buni qilganingiz qanday aqllilik! Qanday chiroyli ko'ylak!

patterns.formula: If I were you, I wouldn't + FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: If I were you, I wouldn't eat so many sweets.
patterns.exampleUz: Sening o'rningda bo'lsam, buncha shirinlik yemasdim.

patterns.formula: KIM + didn't + FE'L + until + KIM + had + V3
patterns.exampleEn: He didn't go to bed until he had finished his homework.
patterns.exampleUz: U uy vazifasini tugatmaguncha uxlagani yotmadi.
